title: Fix ViewStore binding API for TCA 1.23.1

title: Complete TCA 1.23.1 migration and verify build

title: Document TCA 1.23.1 migration changes for team
description:
Create or update migration guide documenting:
- Store() syntax change from (initialState:, reducer:) to (initialState:) { Reducer() }
- ReducerProtocol → Reducer rename
- EffectTask → Effect rename
- .task -> .run { send in } pattern with await send(action)
- ViewStore binding refactoring approach
- @Bindable macro pattern when available

For team reference and future similar migrations.

title: Investigate @Bindable macro for TCA 1.23.1 Views
description: TCA 1.23.1 introduces @Bindable macro for cleaner state binding in Views. Consider refactoring view bindings to use this new pattern instead of ViewStore.binding() for improved code clarity and compatibility with new TCA architecture.

title: Audit effect handling for TCA 1.18+ changes
description: TCA 1.18 changed store effect lifecycle - effects now cancel on store deallocation. Audit fire-and-forget effects (e.g., analytics, persistence) to ensure they don't rely on outliving the store. May need to wrap in unstructured Task{}.

title: Update all @ObservedObject ViewStore declarations to TCA 1.23+ patterns
description: TCA 1.23.1 changes how ViewStore is used in Views. Update patterns from @ObservedObject var viewStore: ViewStoreOf<Reducer> to use @Bindable macro or new View builder syntax. Affects 42 Swift files in Sources directory.

title: Replace ReducerProtocol with Reducer macro across all reducers
Migrate store.scope to TCA 1.5+ key path variants
description: Update NavigationLinkStore scope calls from deprecated store.scope(state:action:) syntax to TCA 1.5+ key path variants. Currently using closure workaround which works but generates warnings. 8 locations in AppView.

title: TCA 1.23.1 API Breaking Changes: viewStore.binding() requires @ObservableState
description: The current codebase uses TCA 0.x patterns with ViewStore and store.binding() which require states to conform to ObservableState in TCA 1.23.1. Requires marking all State types with @ObservableState macro, removing @BindingState, removing ViewStore usage in favor of direct store access, and updating view patterns.

Include code examples, affected patterns, and migration strategies.
